AMENDMENT OF SRI LANKA NURSING SERVICE MINUTE

By the order of the Public Service Commission.
ANURA JAYAWICKRAMA,
Secretary,Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine.
At the Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine,No. 385,Rev. Baddegama Wimalawansa Thero Mawatha,Colombo 10,11th May 2016.
Ministry of Health, Nutrition and Indigenous Medicine

6.2.3.1.1 Recruitment on Results of the G. C. E (A/L) Examination

Should have passed any 03 subjects from Biology, Chemistry, Agriculture, Physics and Mathematics which belongto Bio Science subjects stream in one sitting at the G. C. E. (A/L) Examination. (Except Common General Test andGeneral English)
Or

Should have passed any 03 subjects from Combined Mathematics, Chemistry, Physics and Advanced Mathematicswhich belong to Physical Science subjects stream in one sitting at the G. C. E. (A/L) Examination. (Except CommonGeneral Test and General Engilsh)

6.2.4.1 Recruitment on Results of the G. C. E. (A/L) Examination in a certain year
The total number to be recruited from the island will be divided in proportion to the population in each districtand then the number recruited from each district will be decided.

The number to be recruited from each district will be divided in proportion to the number of applicants who applyfrom Bio Science and Physical Science subject streams in the respective district and are eligible after the general interviewand then, the number recruited from each subjects stream in the respective district will be decided.

The number of recruits from each subjects stream will be decided as such and out of that number 5% is for maleapplicants and 95% is for female applicants. Selections will be made from the applicants who have obtained the highest Z-score in the respective district.
6.2.4.2 Recruitment on Results of the G. C. E. (A/L) Examination in two or more years
The total number to be recruited from the island will be divided in proportion to the population in each districtand the then number recruited from each district will be decided.

The number recruited from each district will be divided in proportion to the number of applicants who apply fromthe respective district in each year and are eligible after the interview and then, the number recruited from the respectivedistrict in each year will be decided.

After that, the number recuited in each year will be divided in proportion to the number of applicants who applyfrom the Bio Science and Physical Science subject streams in the respective year and are eligible after the generalinterview and then the number recruited from the respective district from each subject stream in each year will be decided.

The number of recruits from each subjects stream in each year will be decided as such and out of that number, 5%is for male applicants and 95% is for female applicants. Selections will be made from the applicants who have obtainedthe highest Z-score from each subject stream in the respective district in each year.
